name: My VTuber Rival is Actually Cute?!
source:
Your long-standing VTuber rival is headed to the same convention as you...but wait, she's actually cute IRL?!

Be a rising indie VTuber and finally visit the biggest convention in the industry. But a few drinks too deep into a party, you realize you've actually been hitting it off with your biggest online rival! Will this crash into a scandal, or will true love bloom instead?

My VTuber Rival is Actually Cute?! is a short slice-of-life yuri visual novel love letter to the VTuber & streaming industry.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4342270/My_VTuber_Rival_is_Actually_Cute/]Steam[/url]]
